title: Stock or ETF? 3 showdowns that reveal which one an AI would own:Salesforce vs VOO, JPMorgan vs VFH. Would you rather own the stock orthe basket?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Is one great stock worth more than the whole basket? Today's showdowns  
pit Salesforce against the S&P 500, JPMorgan against the entire  
financial sector, and a single retail REIT against about 60 high-yield  
small caps. The AI picked a side in each. Which would you own?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. CRM vs VOO\*\* — A high-beta software stock with strong AI-driven  
earnings but a weak trend vs the whole S&P 500 for a tiny fee. Which  
one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/crm-vs-voo-weighing-salesforce-stock-against-the-s-p-500-etf-39535/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/crm-vs-voo-weighing-salesforce-stock-against-the-s-p-500-etf-39535/)  
  
\*\*2. JPM vs VFH\*\* — One mega-cap bank vs the entire financial sector  
in one ticker. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the  
link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/jpmorgan-chase-jpm-vs-vanguard-financials-etf-vfh-weighing-concentrated-vs-diversified-financial-exposure-39577/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/jpmorgan-chase-jpm-vs-vanguard-financials-etf-vfh-weighing-concentrated-vs-diversified-financial-exposure-39577/)  
  
\*\*3. BFS vs XSHD\*\* — One retail landlord's concentrated yield vs about  
60 high-yield, low-volatility small caps. Which one does the AI favor?  
The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/bfs-vs-xshd-a-retail-reit-s-concentrated-yield-play-against-an-etf-s-defensive-stability-39552/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/bfs-vs-xshd-a-retail-reit-s-concentrated-yield-play-against-an-etf-s-defensive-stability-39552/)  
  
Stock or ETF: which would you rather hold for the next year? The AI's  
pick is in each link.  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
